The '''Imperial Army Training Center''' was a military training center established on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] second [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]], at the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the early [[Galactic Standard Calendar|days]] of the new [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Centax-2 had been a military staging ground for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and, more secretly, the location of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]]-created [[Clone trooper/Legends#Secret clone army|second clone army]]. These [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], grown in just a single [[Standard year/Legends|year]], were trained at the facility prior to being deployed in the field. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the Empire, [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] from both [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] and [[Omega Squad]]s were stationed at the center, tasked with assisting in the training of the Empire's Spaarti-grown clones.
